connector.name: A2a Trustgate
connector.registryDescription: A2A TrustGate: 4-gate firewall that screens every AI-agent action before it runs. 49 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.a2ainfrastructure.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package a2a-trustgate. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your A2A TrustGate API key: 'Bearer a2a_...'. Optional — connect keyless to start in onboarding mode and self-provision a tenant in-session.

env.name: A2A_API_KEY
env.description: A2A TrustGate API key (a2a_...). Optional: without a key the server starts and can guide signup; most tools require a key to call the firewall.

env.name: A2A_URL
env.description: Base URL of the A2A TrustGate API. Defaults to https://a2ainfrastructure.com.
